newsitem.title: UK: Britain most optimistic nation in Europe -- poll.
newsitem.headline: Britain most optimistic nation in Europe -- poll.

text.p: Britons are currently the most optimistic people in Europe while Austrians are the most pessimistic, according to a survey released on Monday.

The international poll conducted by British market research company Taylor Nelson showed that 63 percent of Britons aged from 16 to 34 believe 1997 will be a better year than 1996 compared to only 13 percent of Austrians.
The survey questioned 2,100 adults in Britain between December 13 and 17 for the Gallup International Association (GIA) End of Year Poll.
According to the GIA research, Brazil is the most optimistic country in the world with 66 percent of people expressing high hopes for the future.
